role: Post-hoc descriptive audit of the closed J6B finite pilot; not a new performance test
question: Do the mixed pointwise J6B contrasts reflect changes in unconditional failed-closed frequency, scored logical failures, or both?
competing_explanations: Near-ceiling loss is mainly unresolved temporal handoffs; triggered paired differences may be dominated by abort-frequency differences.
Scored logical failures after a completed action, rather than aborts, may dominate some or all paired differences.
Both components may move in different directions; a fixed cohort cannot identify a causal mechanism or a low-risk regime.

scope.unit: The original independent five-round matched history; exactly 128 histories per stochastic cell and exactly eight unconditional arm rows per history.
scope.contrast_set: All 14 preregistered online contrasts from the immutable J6B paired analysis; offline remains descriptive only.

diagnostic_matrix: For every stochastic cell and all eight arms, count mutually exclusive outcome categories on the original unconditional n=128 denominator; retain failure reasons and overlapping scored-winding flags without post-selection.

For all 14 original online contrasts, tabulate the matched 3-by-3 outcome-category cross-tab and exact decomposition of left-minus-right unconditional failure-count difference into failed-closed and scored-failure differences.
Check that the decomposed unconditional difference equals the frozen paired point estimate exactly and that every category/cross-tab sums to n=128.
acceptance: Input hashes, J6B integrity and paired status match; all rows and paired arms are complete; every per-arm and per-contrast denominator and exact decomposition closes. Otherwise stop without scientific interpretation.
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc descriptive accounting of existing unconditional outcomes. It is not a new pointwise or simultaneous significance test, a conditional-on-scored LER estimand, causal mechanism identification, JIT superiority, threshold, or approval for a larger study.
next_operation: Run one read-only diagnostic on frozen J6B rows, integrate the result into Local Wiki and report, and choose the next separately registered scientific question.
